row:
Orange County has
approved additional
restrictions for
parking within the
road right-of-way.
RIGHTS-OF-WAY ARE NOT TO
BE USED AS TEMPORARY
PARKING LOTS
RIGHTS-OF-WAY
ARE NOT TO BE
USED FOR
STORAGE
LARGE VEHICLES
ARE REDUCING
AVAILABLE
PARKING SPACES
FOR RESIDENTS
AND BUSINESSES
The new standards and
penalties are listed on the
reverse side of this notice.

PROHIBITED PARKING &
STORAGE OF CERTAIN
VEHICLES IN ROW
Commercial-use dual real wheel vehicles
($150 parking fine)
Vehicles with no license plate or current
registration
($30 parking fine - subject to tow)
Recreational vehicles (after 72 hrs)
($30 parking fine)
Trailers
($30 parking fine)
Vehicles under car covers
($30 parking fine - subject to tow)
VEHICLES CAUSING A
SAFETY HAZARD
Vehicles blocking visibility causing a safety
hazard
($30 parking fine - subject to tow)
Vehicles blocking 20 ft clear access path
for roads (fire / EMS access)
($30 parking fine)
Blocking mail delivery locations 8am - 6pm
($30 parking fine)
Vehicles parking within 20 feet of
mid-block crossings
($30 parking fine)
Vehicles on shared-use paths
($30 parking fine)
VEHICLES IN PARKING
SPACES
Oversized vehicles using more than one
marked parking space
($30 parking fine)
Parking non EV vehicles in EV parking
spaces
($30 parking fine)
To report: Contact 311 (daytime)
Sheriff non emergency number (24 hours)
